title: Generated AC1027 WIPEOUTVARIABLES DWG adapter transport
scope: Bounded generation-keyed typed WIPEOUTVARIABLES capture, source CLASS/frame and NOD-rooted dictionary binding, same-revision AC1027 output preflight, group-70 domain refusal, atomic rollback/retry, and fresh ASCII/Binary typed readback for a locally authored DWG.

fixture.artifacts: The selector creates one temporary AC1027 DWG and temporary ASCII/Binary DXFs under the system temporary directory; RAII cleanup removes them.

sources.title: Autodesk WIPEOUTFRAME system variable
sources.finding: The system variable documents values 0 (frames hidden/plotted off), 1 (displayed and plotted), and 2 (displayed but not plotted).

sources.title: Autodesk WIPEOUTVARIABLES DXF object
sources.finding: The DXF table documents group 70 as 0/1, lists subclass AcDbRasterVariables and group 90 class version 0. The current and LibreCAD-bundled writers instead emit subclass AcDbWipeoutVariables and omit group 90. The relationship between these definitions is unresolved.

documentationReview.admissionDecision: Retain DWG mode 2 when reading, but refuse DXF group-70 values outside 0/1. No crosswalk between WIPEOUTFRAME mode 2 and WIPEOUTVARIABLES DXF group 70 is inferred.

implementation.behavior: The adapter retains bounded typed records keyed by import generation and handle. Extension-graph inventory and traversal require a unique dictionary child rooted from NOD under ACAD_IMAGE_VARS. Output preflight binds each typed callback to one unchanged published CLASS row, one raw source frame, matching common-link evidence, and the unique owner path. It admits only same-revision AC1027 output with group-70 values 0 or 1, no reactors, extension dictionary, data-storage bytes, EED, or XDATA; it registers the CLASS, reserves the source identity, writes the typed object, and qualifies the source frame only after successful emission.
limits: Typed capture is capped at 1024 records and DRW::kMaxDxfBinaryPayloadBytes of estimated retained data.

The generated selector starts with DWG display-frame value 2, confirms it is retained by the reader, and confirms strict DXF export refuses it atomically. Successful typed output/readback covers only values 0 and 1.

ASCII/Binary typed self-readback establishes transport through this implementation only. The Autodesk subclass/class-version discrepancy, physical producer coverage, native frame/plot behavior, other versions, and whole-document closure remain unqualified.

regressionControl.behavior: The adapter selector checks bounded typed/raw capture from the generated DWG, refuses AC1024 target output and unsupported source display values 2 and 3 without changing sentinel destination bytes, then retries on the same adapter with values 1 and 0. It verifies source-frame output binding and fresh ASCII/Binary typed readback with exactly one WIPEOUTVARIABLES entry under the unique ACAD_IMAGE_VARS dictionary path. A direct-writer control checks ASCII/Binary rejection of values 2, 3, and 65535 and corrected mode-1 retry. The focused wave1 selector also checks successful direct output of values 0 and 1.
regressionControl.outputQualification: The selector proves only the generated AC1027 object and its selected source frame/rooted dictionary path. It does not qualify the entire source drawing or native application semantics.
